translations.web: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
translations.bsb: He has inscribed a horizon on the face of the waters at the boundary between light and darkness.
translations.kjv: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.
translations.asv: He hath described a boundary upon the face of the waters, Unto the confines of light and darkness.
